marks.label: Be #2 to become #1
marks.sub: A party game where the most popular answer scores nothing.

marks.label: Solo game
marks.sub: Five questions against 15 computer players. With friends, everyone joins by code on their phone.

marks.label: The question
marks.sub: Everyone answers in a word or two.

marks.label: Aim for #2
marks.sub: Guess what the crowd’s second favourite answer will be.

marks.label: The reveal
marks.sub: Answers are tallied and revealed from the bottom up.

marks.label: Just right
marks.sub: The #1 answer is too popular and scores 0. #2 scores 3, #3 scores 2.

marks.label: Leaderboard
marks.sub: Scores add up over the five questions.
